q1_issues.issue: 'Parrish's ruling' is encoded as (Possession sk_ruling_1 parrish), but a genitive naming an event noun's underlying subject — the instruction set's own example is 'the committee's ruling' — must take that noun's subject role; Possession there asserts a relation the text never states.

That possessor link is stated only inside the sealed said/thought complement yet is emitted at top level, while the projection table lets exactly Member/Name typing and definitional decomposition atoms out of an attitude seal and keeps possessor / Of links sealed.

'perhaps U.S. District Court' is flattened into a second (Goal sk_appeal_1 us_district_court) on the same appeal event: the hedge 'perhaps' is dropped, so one appeal is asserted to go to both courts unhedged.

q2_gaps: coordination of two oblique goals on one verb with the second scoped under a hedging adverb ('to a higher state court and perhaps U.S. District Court'): the coordination section covers clauses/VPs and noun phrases, not adjunct/oblique coordination

an attributive comparative inside a fused compound kind ('a higher state court'): the elided-standard comparative bar forbids exposing the modifier as a genus, and the instruction set does not say whether the comparative should instead be recorded as a gap
